raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly assumed the next town after Mummulgum on the Bruxner Highway was Lismore, leading to pursuit of Wilsons River. The initial search snippet already indicated Mummulgum is between Tenterfield and Casino, making Casino the next town—Casino sits on the Richmond River. This misidentification of the town caused the wrong river to be targeted and verified.
